invariants.rule: A Form has distinct stable identity and never replaces the selected base species identity.
Temporary or alternate form state never erases base species, lineage, selection or historical receipts.
Every transformation explicitly identifies retained/replaced contribution policy across affected shared-owner surfaces; absence is unresolved.
Transformation-time equipment behavior is explicit as retain/drop/suppress/resize/replace/adapt/owner-defined, while authoritative equipment mutation remains with PPIA-03/Item-Equipment owners.
Exit/reversal preserves the original transition and pre-transform provenance; history is never overwritten or erased.
Morphology, scale, movement, senses, capabilities, resources, equipment and presentation mechanics remain with their shared owners and are referenced or handed off.
Species progression remains MVPS-10 and deterministic active contribution/runtime grant projection remains MVPS-13.
